titulo: O passado do to be: was e were: Datas e ordinais

aula.titulo: O passado do to be: was e were
aula.objetivo: Falar do passado com «was» e «were», dizer onde você estava e como foi, usar ordinais e datas, e marcar o passado com «yesterday», «last» e «ago».

blocos.explicacao: PASSO 1: Observe como o passado do verbo to be se divide em apenas dois blocos: PASSO 2: Perguntas: PASSO 3: Quais pessoas usam was e quais usam were? PASSO 4: Por que dizemos There was a lot of traffic (com was), mas There were a lot of people (com were)?

tabela.c1: I was in Chicago last week.
tabela.c2: You were in a meeting ten minutes ago.
We weren't late for the flight.

tabela.c1: Was she at the office yesterday? — Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't.
tabela.c2: Were they happy with the result? — Yes, they were. / No, they weren't.

tabela.c1: There was a lot of traffic.
tabela.c2: There were 500 people at the event.

blocos.explicacao: PASSO 1: os três primeiros são irregulares: first (1st), second (2nd), third (3rd). PASSO 2: a partir do quarto, acrescente -th: fourth, fifth (note: five → fifth), sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth. PASSO 3: dezenas terminadas em -ty trocam o -y por -ieth: twentieth, thirtieth. PASSO 4: datas nos EUA: MÊS + dia: «October 7th» (7 de outubro) e escrito «10/7». No Brasil é dia/mês: tome cuidado! PASSO 5: fale a data assim: «It's October seventh.» ou «October the seventh». PASSO 6: ano: «nineteen ninety-nine» (1999), «two thousand twenty-six» ou «twenty twenty-six» (2026). PASSO 7: «My birthday is on May 3rd.»
blocos.comparacao: em português a data vai DIA/MÊS (7/10). Nos EUA vai MÊS/DIA (10/7). Um erro aqui pode marcar um compromisso no mês errado.

blocos.explicacao: PASSO 1: Conjugação de to be no Passado (“foi, era, estava, ficava”): PASSO 2: I / he / she / it → Afirmativa: was (uóz) | Negativa: wasn't (uó-zânt) | Pergunta: Was I / he / she / it…?. PASSO 3: you / we / they → Afirmativa: were (uâr) | Negativa: weren't (uârnt) | Pergunta: Were you / we / they…?. PASSO 4: Respostas curtas:Yes, I was / No, I wasn't; Yes, they were / No, they weren't. PASSO 5: Existência no Passado (“Havia / Tinha”): PASSO 6: Singular / Incontável:There was / There wasn't / Was there…? (There was a problem / There was a lot of traffic). PASSO 7: Plural:There were / There weren't / Were there…? (There were twenty people in line). PASSO 8: Nascimento: Sempre com was / were born (I was born in 1994 / Where were you born?). PASSO 9: Marcadores de Passado (Sem preposição antes de yesterday e last!): PASSO 10: yesterday (yesterday morning / afternoon / evening), mas last night (“ontem à noite”). PASSO 11: last + período (last week, last month, last year, last weekend, last Friday). PASSO 12: Período + ago (ten minutes ago, two days ago, three years ago).

blocos.enunciado: Diga 5 datas importantes na sua vida, no formato americano.
Diga em inglês: «ele estava cansado», «elas não estavam em casa», «você estava no trabalho?»
